description: This PHP source file renders a web page for parental control reports, including filter options, dynamic report display sections for managed sites, services, devices, and all reports, with associated JavaScript for handling report generation, pagination, and UI interactions.

methods.name: adjust_acs_tb
methods.description: Adjusts the attributes of a visible table, setting its summary, converting header cells, and assigning headers to data cells for accessibility and styling.

methods.name: ajaxDo
methods.description: Performs an AJAX request to retrieve report data based on mode and time frame, then populates the corresponding report table and initializes pagination.
